allowed_domains.description: List of domains to allow fetching from
allowed_domains.title: Allowed Domains

blocked_domains.description: List of domains to block fetching from
blocked_domains.title: Blocked Domains

cache_control.description: Create a cache control breakpoint at this content block.
cache_control.title: Cache Control

citations.description: Citations configuration for fetched documents. Citations are disabled by default.

defer_loading.description: If true, tool will not be included in initial system prompt. Only loaded when returned via tool_reference from tool search.
defer_loading.title: Defer Loading

max_content_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens used by including web page text content in the context. The limit is approximate and does not apply to binary content such as PDFs.
max_content_tokens.title: Max Content Tokens

max_uses.description: Maximum number of times the tool can be used in the API request.
max_uses.title: Max Uses

name.description:
Name of the tool.

This is how the tool will be called by the model and in `tool_use` blocks.
name.title: Name

strict.description: When true, guarantees schema validation on tool names and inputs
strict.title: Strict

url_sources.description: Which sources contribute to the set of URLs the tool may fetch. Omitted means every source.
